title: Lovely Light Catalan Pork Tripe Fabada Asturiana
description: Fatty and flavorful dish originating from Catalonia, suitable for a post-hangover meal.
instructions: Rinse the pork tripe and cut it into bite-sized pieces.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the sliced onions and cook until softened, about 8 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the chorizo and cook for 2 minutes, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the pork tripe, white wine, chicken broth, and bay leaves.
Bring to a boil, then cover and transfer to the preheated oven.
Bake for 2 hours, or until the tripe is tender and the meat is easily shredded.
Season with salt and tabasco sauce to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
